newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO STOCKS TO DRIFT, DOWNSIDE SUPPORTED BY NY.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO STOCKS TO DRIFT, DOWNSIDE SUPPORTED BY NY.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to drift on Thursday, with the downside supported by another record high on Wall Street overnight and the upside capped by arbitrage selling, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the Nikkei 225 ended 187.62 points or 0.96 percent higher at 19,702.07. September Nikkei futures added 310 to 19,750.
"The market is hoping that the Dow's new high on Wall Street will breathe life into blue chips which have been slowing down lately," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
